notes: All six snapshots are Common Crawl captures (CC-MAIN-2020-40); sourceUrl is the index lookup address from each file footer and sourceDate the capture timestamp date. Berkeley Haas "Recent Job Placements" (2020-09-25): years are explicitly "year of graduation" (yearMeaning graduation); 91 placement rows 2013-2020 plus 5 sidebar alumni (PhD 09/08/07/95/87, two-digit degree years expanded; roles in the sidebar are not attached to individual names). Two 2018 entries (Carlos Avenancio- León, Sheisha Kulkarni) list a postdoc and an assistant professorship on consecutive lines; the postdoc is recorded as destination/position and the professorship in note. The page gives no department; degree "PhD" is taken from the PhD Program page context, not from a per-person label. Berkeley Haas "Alumni Network" (2020-09-25): 16 alumni profile teasers with "PhD YY" degree years (expanded to four digits; yearMeaning graduation) and no placements. Program recorded only for Seungmin Chee and Jenny Chu, whose teasers explicitly mention accounting at the doctoral level; others left null even when the teaser hints at a field. Wharton "Students on the Job Market" (2020-09-25): the page gives no season or year, so listedYear is null with yearMeaning job-market. The capture date is September 2020 but the content appears to be an earlier season (Carson Young is listed as a Ph.D. 2019 recipient on the LGST placement page in this chunk), so the integrator should not assume a 2020-21 market. Accounting, Health Care Management & Economics and Statistics sections are empty; Applied Economics and Finance refer to department sites not in this chunk. Wharton LGST "Ethics & Legal Studies Doctoral Program Career Placement" (2020-09-30): "(Ph.D. YYYY)" recorded as graduation year; placements are given as institutions without titles; the page describes them as tenure-track placement results. Name "Gastón de los Reyes, Jr ." kept as printed with the stray space. USC Marshall "Alumni Achievements" (2020-09-28): a selective accolades page, not a complete graduate list. "Ph.D. ‘YY" degree years expanded to four digits (yearMeaning graduation); destination is the "Initial Placement" field ("Placement" for Peter Golder) and the current position is kept in note. Departments are not named on the page; program left null. Yale SOM "Job Market Candidates" (2020-10-01): season "2019-2020" recorded as listedYear 2020 with yearMeaning job-market and the range quoted in note; candidate email addresses were not copied.
